text:
Ashley: Heads up — ran a privilege-entropy scan across prod IAM bindings. Found ~72 admin-like grants that look risky (cross-project service accounts, owner grants on infra roles). Will drop top findings here for triage.
Matt: Yikes. Can you paste the top 5 w/ reasoning and resource examples?
Ashley: Top5: 1) svc-analytics-prod -> roles/owner on payments-project (3 principals) 2) deployer-sa -> roles/iam.admin on staging-cluster (CI service) 3) human:jordan -> roles/orgAdmin role in org-level binding 4) backup-sa -> roles/compute.admin in onprem-mirror 5) legacy-infra -> roles/editor on billing-project. Each shows little justification in recent access logs. Logs hint: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy payments-project --flatten=bindings` and audit filter snippets attached.
Jordan: omg that's my user — I had an emergency access for migration last month, thought it was removed. I'll revoke if needed. :grimacing: 
Ashley: @Jordan pls confirm which tasks you still need — if none I'll submit a scoped role request and remove orgAdmin.
Tom: Staging CI deployer is likely from a stale pipeline. @DevOps-Bot can we map last use by SA? Use `auditLogs protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail` filter to find last auth.
DevOps-Bot: query started: lastAuth for deployer-sa on staging-cluster -> last seen 2025-11-19T03:12:45Z
Matt: Backup-sa on onprem-mirror — is that reachable? Might be left over from the old backup runner.
Sarah: Let's schedule a short remediation window. Security to own runbook for owner->restricted roles; Compliance will record evidence for the next audit.
Ashley: I'll push a PR to the entitlement playbook with steps: 1) notify owner 2) create scoped role 3) run canary removal 4) validate via audit logs 5) record evidence in GCS. Drafting now.
Jordan: confirmed I no longer need orgAdmin; I'll accept scoped role. Removing access now.
Ashley: thanks — marking items: payments svc, staging deployer, jordan org-admin, backup-sa, legacy-infra. I'll open tickets and assign owners.
Matt: Also recommend enabling KMS key usage audit bindings for those service accounts so key access is visible.
Sarah: +1. Add retention for key audit logs to 1y for these projects and capture evidence snapshot.
Ashley: created tickets: TICKET-4521, TICKET-4522, TICKET-4523, TICKET-4524, TICKET-4525. I assigned owners and put remediation checklists in the tickets. :white_check_mark: 
DevOps-Bot: permission-change detection rule will watch these principals for 72h; alert channel: #sec-privilege-watch.
Tom: ping me if any removal breaks CI — we can rollback via canary.
Ashley: closing thread for now — will post updates in tickets. Thanks everyone. :heart:
